topic: When to surface a model-profile prompt
observations: This read-only status request was complete before its final model card; the user then had to handle the card as a separate profile task.
AGENTS.md and model-policy.md explicitly require a card before the first role delegation or, if none, at the final report of any substantial task.
Execution allocation already permits direct handling when no role assignment is needed; a task can continue on the current session model without a profile.
A profile choice is useful before actual model-specific role dispatch and can be saved without waiting for a response.
options: Keep the final card on every substantial task; preserve an opportunity to save profile, at the cost of unrelated prompts after read-only work.
Show the card only when a role/model assignment is imminent or the user asks for model advice; roleless work gets no card, and model answers never replace active task ownership.
selected: Show the card only when a role/model assignment is imminent or the user asks for model advice; roleless work gets no card, and model answers never replace active task ownership.
rationale: This directly removes the evidenced distraction while retaining a choice point when it can affect a real role assignment. The default remains the already selected session model, so omitting the optional card cannot block or change active work.
